_source.title: 获取当前原理图的详细属性
_source.remarks.text.0: 将会获取当前打开且拥有最后输入焦点的原理图图页所关联的原理图的详细属性
_source.returns: 原理图的详细属性，如若为 `undefined` 则获取失败

title: Get detailed properties of Current schematic
remarks.text.0: It will get the detailed properties of the schematic associated with the currently open schematic sheet that has the last input focus
returns: Schematic detailed properties of; if it is `undefined`, the retrieval failed
